description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a Vancouver-born, local family bakery operating continuously since 2006 across 8 locations, including this East Hastings outpost. It is one of the rare cafes open around the clock every day of the year, making it a reliable stop for cyclists at any hour. The menu spans artisan breads, pastries, sandwiches, soups, cakes, and hot beverages, with dedicated gluten-free and vegan selections.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Breka Bakery & Café is a real, active business operating 24/7 at one of 8 Vancouver locations including East Hastings Street, consistent with the OSM record. The website's 'Our Selection' page has explicit GLUTEN-FREE and VEGAN sections with multiple named items, and a 'Grab & Go' menu category plus an online ordering app confirming takeout. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or pump appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website.

Website lists East Hastings Street as one of 8 locations but does not provide individual street-level addresses, so the specific OSM address (2434 East Hastings Street) cannot be confirmed from website content alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible 24/7 bakery and café confirmed by website; highly useful to touring cyclists at any hour.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website has dedicated 'VEGAN' and 'GLUTEN-FREE' (labelled 'Gluten Friendly') menu sections with multiple named items including vegan wraps, chia puddings, granola cookies, and gluten-free mousse cakes

wow_evidence: one of the rare cafes open around the clock every day of the year
